content: Circuit breaker for queues (docs-verified primitives): Queue.pause() stops pickup globally without interrupting in-flight jobs; Worker.pause() local; graceful close waits for in-flight; pattern: on infra-failure rate threshold -> pause producer queue, drain with bounded attempts, HALF_OPEN probe job, resume on success; backlog cap by skipping droppable routine enqueues (scheduler re-claims next tick).
